newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Jan-June fish catches slide 18 pct vs 1996.
newsitem.headline: Chile Jan-June fish catches slide 18 pct vs 1996.

text.p: Chilean fish catches fell 18 percent in the first half of the year compared with the same period in 1996, mainly as a result of bans on mackerel fishing, said the Fisheries Undersecretariat.
Catches of mackerel -- the main ingredient in fishmeal -- fell to 1.8 million tonnes, down 1.2 million tonnes on the first six months of last year, said the statement.
The government has imposed five temporary fishing bans this year to protect young mackerel drawn close to the coast by the rise in ocean temperatures caused by the El Nino phenomenon.
The situation was partly offset by a 45 percent rise in catches of anchovy, it said.

Government officials have said Chile's fishmeal production will fall sharply this year as a result of the decline in mackerel catches. Chile is the world's second largest fishmeal producer after Peru.
